metadata.title: The Failed ERP Implementation
metadata.summary: Asteron Systems pursues its ERP supplier after a failed implementation, while scope changes, acceptance language, causation, evidence, deadlines, and layered remedies shape the result.
metadata.author: GENESIS: JURIS

actors.name: Player
actors.description: Counsel responsible for Asteron Systems' failed ERP matter.

actors.name: Asteron Systems NV
actors.description: The ERP buyer and claimant, seeking recovery of an estimated EUR 240,000 loss.

actors.name: Northbridge Consulting BV
actors.description: The ERP supplier and defendant, relying on scope change, data, governance, acceptance, and causation defences.

facts.statement: Asteron Systems and Northbridge Consulting entered into the ERP implementation contract.
The delivered ERP implementation did not achieve a usable go-live.
Asteron Systems claims EUR 240,000 in implementation losses.
Responsibility for informal scope changes affects breach and causation.
Project correspondence records unresolved defects and supplier-side delay notices.
Asteron's delivery acceptance was conditional rather than an unqualified acceptance of performance.
Northbridge's architecture and delivery-control failures amounted to material supplier breach.
Supplier failures materially caused Asteron's implementation loss, subject to scope-change and mitigation allocation.

evidence.title: Signed ERP implementation agreement
evidence.description: The scope, milestones, acceptance language, and liability framework.

evidence.title: Change request register
evidence.description: The formal and informal scope changes recorded during delivery.

evidence.title: Project email correspondence
evidence.description: Project messages recording defects, escalation, delay, and changing requirements.

evidence.title: Conditional delivery acceptance record
evidence.description: The delivery record and the qualifications attached to acceptance.

evidence.title: Independent ERP expert report
evidence.description: A technical assessment of architecture, delivery control, scope changes, breach, and causation.

actions.title: Run conflict check
actions.description: Verify whether the firm can ethically accept Asteron Systems as claimant.

actions.title: Accept matter immediately
actions.description: Secure the client before completing formal checks, weakening the procedural and ethical record.

actions.title: Ask AI associate for legal research
actions.description: Identify scope, acceptance, causation, liability-limit and loss issues that require human verification.

actions.title: Reply to client CFO
actions.description: Set expectations and explain the evidence-first plan to Asteron's finance team.

actions.title: Request and review full document set
actions.description: Review the contract, change register, project correspondence, and conditional acceptance record.

actions.title: Delegate first-pass review
actions.description: Use a junior associate for a first-pass chronology while retaining validation responsibility.

actions.title: Review junior document findings
actions.description: Validate chronology gaps, acceptance risks, and source references before relying on them.

actions.title: Prepare partner risk brief
actions.description: Document merits, evidence gaps, budget exposure, and settlement range before the internal deadline.

actions.title: Issue evidence-preservation notice
actions.description: Place project mailboxes, tickets, acceptance records, and escalation logs on legal hold.

actions.title: Request additional budget approval
actions.description: Ask Asteron Systems to authorize another EUR 25,000.

actions.title: Commission independent ERP expert
actions.description: Start an independent technical assessment of architecture, delivery control, breach, and causation.

actions.title: Ask AI associate for damages model
actions.description: Recalculate risk-adjusted value against the current known-facts revision and the EUR 240,000 claim.

actions.title: Review independent expert report
actions.description: Validate the report before adding its breach and causation findings to the evidentiary record.

actions.title: Accept current settlement offer
actions.description: Resolve the matter for EUR 64,500 without admission of liability.

actions.title: Reject current settlement offer
actions.description: Decline EUR 64,500 and continue preparing the claim.

actions.title: Commence proceedings
actions.description: File the originating application and move the dispute into formal pleadings.

actions.title: Prepare and file statement of claim
actions.description: Define the pleaded breach, causation case, damages, and requested relief.

actions.title: Prepare and file evidence bundle
actions.description: Organize the contract, correspondence, acceptance record, and reviewed expert findings for hearing.

actions.title: Request hearing rescheduling
actions.description: Ask the court to move the first enterprise-court hearing four days later.

actions.title: Advance clock to enterprise court hearing
actions.description: Advance to the active scheduled hearing while all crossed deadlines and asynchronous work remain authoritative.

actions.title: Attend enterprise court hearing
actions.description: Present the pleaded case, answer judicial questions, and address Northbridge's defence.

actions.title: Prepare hearing strategy memorandum
actions.description: Map the oral theory, likely questions, weak points, and fallback submissions.

actions.title: Prepare client key witness
actions.description: Review the chronology and likely challenge themes without scripting evidence.

actions.title: Reconcile damages schedule
actions.description: Tie invoices, replacement costs, mitigation, and expert findings to the pleaded EUR 240,000 quantum.

actions.title: Inform client and explain judgment
actions.description: Brief Asteron on the result, damages, enforcement, and further-review risk.

actions.title: Prepare appeal advice
actions.description: Separate appealable errors from factual disagreement and quantify cost, timing, and prospects.

actions.title: Request client authorization to appeal
actions.description: Present the advice and obtain express authority before filing.

actions.title: File appeal
actions.description: File the authorized challenge on the assessed appellate grounds.

actions.title: Await appeal decision
actions.description: Advance to the next deterministic appellate judgment update.

actions.title: Accept first-instance judgment and close
actions.description: Waive the available appeal and close the matter with the first-instance result recorded.

actions.title: Assess cassation grounds
actions.description: Obtain specialist advice on legal and procedural errors without reopening the facts.

actions.title: Request client authorization for cassation
actions.description: Present the specialist opinion and obtain express authority before filing.

actions.title: File cassation appeal
actions.description: File the authorized claimant-side challenge on the identified legal ground.

actions.title: Accept appellate judgment and close
actions.description: Waive cassation and close the matter with the appellate loss recorded.

actions.title: Prepare response to cassation challenge
actions.description: Address Northbridge's legal grounds while preserving Asteron's favorable judgment.

actions.title: Await Court of Cassation decision
actions.description: Advance to the next deterministic cassation update.

actions.title: Rest until next workday
actions.description: Advance to 08:00 on the next day; fatigue recovers while deadlines and events continue.

actions.title: Continue the admitted cassation review
actions.description: Continue to the focused legal issue's final disposition; this structural lifecycle transition adds no invented billable work or balance.

actions.title: Continue the remitted rehearing
actions.description: Complete the structural remittal step and return the open matter to the existing judgment-update path without invented time, cost, or balance.

inbox_items.subject: Urgent: ERP supplier termination notice
inbox_items.body: Our ERP supplier terminated the project and denies responsibility. We estimate losses of EUR 240,000. Some requirements changed, but the system still failed. Can you take the case?

inbox_items.subject: Board expects visible action
inbox_items.body: Asteron's board expects a response today and is losing patience.

inbox_items.subject: Evidence preservation required
inbox_items.body: Project mailboxes, tickets, acceptance records, and escalation logs must be preserved before Day 2 at 17:00.

inbox_items.subject: Document review in progress
inbox_items.body: Initial findings are expected at 13:30 and require senior validation.

inbox_items.subject: Document review findings ready for validation
inbox_items.body: The junior identified chronology gaps, acceptance-language risks, and correspondence requiring senior validation before use.

inbox_items.subject: Without-prejudice settlement offer
inbox_items.body: Northbridge offers EUR 64,500 without admission of liability. The offer expires on Day 2 at 17:30.

inbox_items.subject: Technical assessment commissioned
inbox_items.body: The independent ERP expert has started a protected technical assessment.

inbox_items.subject: Technical assessment ready for review
inbox_items.body: The report identifies supplier-side architecture and delivery-control failures while allocating part of the delay to informal scope changes.

inbox_items.subject: Proceedings opened
inbox_items.body: The originating filing has been registered. Prepare and file the statement of claim.

inbox_items.subject: Statement of claim filed
inbox_items.body: The pleaded allegations, legal basis, and requested relief are on record. Prepare the evidentiary bundle.

inbox_items.subject: Enterprise court hearing scheduled
inbox_items.body: Attendance is mandatory. A rescheduling request does not suspend the original date unless the court grants it.

inbox_items.subject: Hearing postponement granted
inbox_items.body: The original date is vacated and a replacement hearing is scheduled four days later at 14:00.

inbox_items.subject: Enterprise court hearing now in session
inbox_items.body: Attend now within the six-hour attendance window or risk a mandatory procedural default.

inbox_items.subject: Enterprise court judgment issued
inbox_items.body: The court has issued its first-instance result. Explain the result and any open remedy to Asteron.

inbox_items.subject: Prepare appeal advice
inbox_items.body: Asteron requests a candid assessment of appeal grounds, cost, timing, and prospects.

inbox_items.subject: Client decision required on appeal
inbox_items.body: Present the recommendation and request express authority to appeal, or accept the judgment and close.

inbox_items.subject: Appeal filed
inbox_items.body: The authorized appeal is on record while the first-instance result remains authoritative pending review.

inbox_items.subject: Assess cassation options
inbox_items.body: Asteron requests specialist advice on legal or procedural grounds. Factual disagreement alone is insufficient.

inbox_items.subject: Client decision required on cassation
inbox_items.body: Request authority to file on the assessed legal ground, or accept the appellate judgment and close.

inbox_items.subject: Cassation filing recorded
inbox_items.body: The Court of Cassation will review legality rather than retry the facts.

inbox_items.subject: Northbridge filed a cassation challenge
inbox_items.body: Northbridge challenges alleged legal errors in Asteron's favorable judgment. Prepare a focused response.

inbox_items.subject: Limited cassation review admitted
inbox_items.body: A limited legal issue has been admitted. The prior judgment remains authoritative and the matter remains open until final disposition.

inbox_items.subject: Judgment quashed and remitted
inbox_items.body: The court accepted a legal ground and remitted the matter for rehearing. The factual merits are not finally determined.

inbox_items.subject: Partner risk brief missed
inbox_items.body: Partner oversight, settlement planning, procedure, and client confidence have deteriorated.

inbox_items.subject: Evidence-preservation deadline missed
inbox_items.body: Relevant records may be incomplete; the evidentiary ceiling and ethical record are reduced.

inbox_items.subject: Settlement offer expired
inbox_items.body: The EUR 64,500 commercial exit expired without acceptance. Formal proceedings remain available.

inbox_items.subject: Claim dismissed by procedural default
inbox_items.body: The statement of claim was not completed by its mandatory deadline and the final default closed the claim.

inbox_items.subject: Mandatory hearing missed
inbox_items.body: The court may decide on an incomplete record after no timely attendance was recorded.

inbox_items.subject: Appeal deadline expired
inbox_items.body: No authorized appeal was completed by the deadline. The first-instance adverse result is final.

inbox_items.subject: Cassation deadline expired
inbox_items.body: No authorized cassation appeal was completed by the deadline. The appellate loss is final.

inbox_items.subject: Urgent engagement warning
inbox_items.body: The client has seen no substantive progress for three simulated hours. Immediate action and a credible plan are required to preserve the engagement.

inbox_items.subject: Final warning before termination
inbox_items.body: The client considers the continuing inactivity a material service failure. The engagement will be terminated unless substantive work resumes immediately.

inbox_items.subject: Engagement terminated for inactivity
inbox_items.body: The client terminated the mandate after repeated warnings and sustained lack of substantive progress. The firm must write off part of the fees and record the service failure internally.

inbox_items.subject: Matter closed
inbox_items.body: The Failed ERP Implementation has reached an explicit terminal closure. The final report is available.

events.title: Independent ERP assessment expired before review
Close open statement of claim deadline

outcomes.title: Client terminated engagement
outcomes.summary: Repeated warnings were ignored and Asteron ended the engagement for sustained inactivity. No recovery was achieved; professional standing and client trust were materially reduced.

outcomes.title: Settlement accepted for EUR 64,500
outcomes.summary: Asteron accepts Northbridge's without-prejudice EUR 64,500 payment and explicitly closes the matter without an admission of liability.

outcomes.title: Claim dismissed by final procedural default
outcomes.summary: The mandatory claim filing was not completed in time. With no executable cure remaining, the adverse procedural result is final and the matter is closed.

outcomes.title: Claim substantially upheld
outcomes.summary: Asteron proves material supplier breach and substantial loss; no further challenge remains open and the favorable first-instance judgment is final.

outcomes.title: First-instance adverse result accepted
outcomes.summary: Asteron waives or loses the available appeal route, making the first-instance adverse or mixed result final.

outcomes.title: Claim allowed on appeal
outcomes.summary: The appellate court sets aside the adverse first-instance result and grants substantial relief to Asteron; the matter is explicitly closed.

outcomes.title: Appellate loss becomes final
outcomes.summary: Asteron's appeal fails and no executable cassation remedy remains after waiver, refusal, or expiry.

outcomes.title: Claimant cassation appeal dismissed
outcomes.summary: The Court of Cassation rejects Asteron's asserted legal ground and the appellate loss is final.

outcomes.title: Favorable judgment preserved after cassation
outcomes.summary: Northbridge's cassation challenge is finally dismissed and Asteron's favorable judgment remains effective.
